commands.name: play
commands.description: Play in your voice channel, or add to the queue

commands.name: playnext
commands.description: Queue something as the next track

commands.name: skipto
commands.description: Jump straight to a queued track

commands.name: seek
commands.description: Jump to a position in the track

commands.name: volume
commands.description: Set the room general volume (Admins & Moderators)

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Repeat the track or the queue

commands.name: nowplaying
commands.description: Show the player with a seek bar

commands.name: longhistory
commands.description: Everything this room played lately (up to 250)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove one track from the queue

commands.name: removedupes
commands.description: Drop duplicate tracks from the queue

commands.name: grab
commands.description: Send the current track to your DMs

commands.name: radio
commands.description: Endless songs that fit a mood

commands.name: like
commands.description: Teach the bot you like this track

commands.name: dislike
commands.description: Keep this track out of autoplay

commands.name: join
commands.description: Bring the bot into your Discord voice channel

commands.name: 247start
commands.description: Keep the bot in the channel (Discord)

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Watch Together in your voice room; with a link, add it to the party (or play it on the room's screen)

commands.name: reels
commands.description: Reels Together in your voice room: swipe Shorts as a group, the feed learns what you like

commands.name: player
commands.description: Full-screen music player: synced lyrics, up next, search, playlists and a DJ

commands.name: dj
commands.description: Open the DJ booth: two decks, mixer, FX and Auto DJ

commands.name: roll
commands.description: Roll dice: /roll d20+5 stealth adv, /roll 2d6+3 sword crit

commands.name: gmroll
commands.description: Roll in secret: only you see the result (/gmroll d20+4 perception)

commands.name: v
commands.description: Vampire V5 roll: d10 pool with red Hunger dice (/v 7 h2 d3 Strength + Brawl)

commands.name: gmv
commands.description: Vampire V5 roll in secret: only you see the result

commands.name: rouse
commands.description: Rouse check: 6+ keeps your Hunger, anything less adds one (/rouse h2 Celerity)

commands.name: w
commands.description: Whisper: only they see it, and it is never saved (/w sam meet me at the door · /w sam,kit you hear a click)

commands.name: monster
commands.description: Look up a monster's stat block

commands.name: record
commands.description: Control a consent-gated D&D session recording

commands.name: poll
commands.description: Start a poll: /poll Question? | option | option

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Ask the AI; it searches the web when the question needs it

commands.name: summarize
commands.description: Catch up: a private AI summary of this channel's recent messages

commands.name: remind
commands.description: Remind yourself later; it arrives in your Notes even if you are offline

commands.name: recap
commands.description: This server's week in numbers; /recap start keeps notes of your call and posts a recap here when it ends

commands.name: schedule
commands.description: Post a message here later, as you (/schedule alone lists and cancels them)

commands.name: game
commands.description: Invite the conversation to a game

commands.name: tts
commands.description: Send a message read aloud to everyone in the channel (/tts off to mute)

commands.name: say
commands.description: Speak text (up to 200 characters) aloud in your voice channel

commands.name: ttsvoice
commands.description: How your /tts and /say sound: slower tempo, deeper pitch, a robot voice (e.g. /ttsvoice tempo 0.85 robot)

commands.name: ttsstop
commands.description: Admins: stop every /tts and /say playing right now, for everyone

commands.name: choose
commands.description: Pick one for you: /choose pizza, tacos, sushi

commands.name: rps
commands.description: Rock, paper, scissors against the bot

commands.name: markdown
commands.description: Toggle markdown tips and code snippet helpers (e.g. ```cpp)

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Moderators: bulk-delete recent messages in this channel
